description: This Java source file provides utility methods for camera operations on Android devices, including selecting optimal video sizes, accessing default cameras, and creating media files.

classes.name: CameraHelper
classes.description: Utility class for camera-related functions such as selecting optimal video size, accessing default cameras, and creating media files.

methods.name: getOptimalVideoSize
methods.description: Selects the best camera video size that fits the view dimensions while maintaining aspect ratio.

methods.name: getDefaultBackFacingCameraInstance
methods.description: Returns the default rear-facing camera instance.

methods.name: getDefaultFrontFacingCameraInstance
methods.description: Returns the default front-facing camera instance.

methods.name: getDefaultCamera
methods.description: Finds and opens a camera based on specified position (front or back).

methods.name: getOutputMediaFile
methods.description: Creates a media file (image or video) in the external pictures directory with a timestamped filename.
